issue_context.title: [Kodi20] The position of ASS\SSA subtitle cannot be set to the bottom of video
issue_context.body:
<!--- Please fill out this template to the best of your ability. You can always edit this issue once you have created it. -->
<!--- Read the following link before you create a new problem report: https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Submit_a_bug_report  -->
## Bug report
### Describe the bug
Here is a clear and concise description of what the problem is:
<!--- Provide a more detailed introduction to the issue itself, and why you consider it to be a bug -->
<!--- A bug report that is not clear will be closed -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
After I upgrade to Kodi20, the position of ASS\SSA subtitle cannot be set to the bottom of video, it seems that `Position of screen` option is not working, it will always be the bottom of screen. Kodi19 is working fine.

## Expected Behavior
Here is a clear and concise description of what was expected to happen:
<!--- Tell us what should happen -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
The position of ASS\SSA subtitle can be set to the bottom of video or the bottom of screen.

## Actual Behavior
<!--- Tell us what happens instead -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
The position of ASS\SSA subtitle can only display at the bottom of screen.


## Possible Fix
<!--- Not obligatory, but suggest a fix or reason for the bug -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
The subtitle position can be overwritten, and we can adjust it manually, but this will cause some bilingual subtitles to work abnormally.


### To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
<!--- Provide a link to a live example, or an unambiguous set of steps to -->
<!--- reproduce this bug. Include code to reproduce, if relevant -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
1. Prepare a movie with ASS subtitles and will be black edges.
2. Play it.

### Debuglog
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
<!--- A debuglog is always mandatory when creating an issue. Provide one! -->
The debuglog can be found here:
[Log of ASS subtitles](https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/files/9567849/kodi.old.log)
[Log of bilingual subtitles](https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/files/9567978/kodi.log)



### Screenshots 
Here are some links or screenshots to help explain the problem:
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
#### Kodi 20, `Position of screen` is set to `bottom of video`:
![sub1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41182852/190201403-a17f10f9-7141-410d-8bc0-15c39ae2e92f.PNG)
![sub2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41182852/190201428-7f01d099-3f97-4893-bdf1-c0b43b97de00.PNG)

![sub3](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41182852/190202550-2590f6e0-778c-4f89-bb3a-facf5e9781ff.PNG)
![sub4](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41182852/190202592-c6b29d3a-3db0-49f7-a35d-2adee8888792.PNG)

![incorrect bilingual subtitles](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41182852/190204678-640d5161-ed06-4d2e-8664-c9cafab89054.png)

![correct bilingual subtitles](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41182852/190204409-b3d08338-0b5e-485e-b3e5-6ba1eca5b20a.png)

Here is some additional context or explanation that might help:

comments:
to investigate on this is needed that you share part of your video that cointains the text subtitles of the screenshots
otherwise at least the subtitle file to see i am able to reproduce it

thanks for the sample,
this is the Windows test build with the fix for normal use case (so with `overridde subtitle styles` settings disabled):
http://mirrors.kodi.tv/test-builds/windows/win64/KodiSetup-20220915-ba350e8f-ass_margin_fix-x64.exe

Some remarks Kodi 20 is not exactly as Kodi 19 for subtitle functionalities, so:

In all cases if you set subtitle position `Bottom of video` you cannot move up/down manually text subtitles, this is a current kodi limitation.

If you want move up/down text manually with ASS/SSA subtitles you have to enable `overridde subtitle styles: position` setting and set position `Manual` or `Bottom of screen`.

If you want force change text positions defined by ASS/SSA authors and use Kodi `Position on screen` setting, you have to enable `overridde subtitle styles: position` setting.

Every time you enable `overridde subtitle styles` or `overridde subtitle fonts` this can lead to side effects to ASS/SSA subtitles, like your screenshot:
![immagine](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3257156/190453058-8a3761ca-3adc-4122-a309-a238a29a1f39.png)
this because is not always possible override ass/ssa styles
so the best is dont enable overridde settings.

Please test the build with more videos and let me know

@CastagnaIT
It works perfectly by default settings (`override subtitle styles settings` disabled and subtitle position is `Bottom of screen`), which is exactly what I want.

Just a question: does `Bottom of screen` and `Bottom of video` affect ASS/SSA subtitle? 
I switched it, but nothing happened. As far as I understand, `Bottom of screen` calculates the position of the subtitle from the bottom of the screen, while `Bottom of video` starts from the bottom of the video. Thus the subtitle may be in the black edge for `Bottom of screen`. I tried SRT subtitles, and it did work.

Anyway, it works, great job!.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41182852/190461051-5d6d2552-8801-403a-a71c-2d2ce954b1fc.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41182852/190461174-6eaa5760-18e7-4614-95f1-dc6c933649c7.png)

> Just a question: does Bottom of screen and Bottom of video affect ASS/SSA subtitle?

does not affect ASS/SSA,
if you want it, then you have to enable "overrides styles: position" setting

> I tried SRT subtitles, and it did work

you have to make sure that the video played with SRT is cropped, otherwise `Bottom of video` will not works and the text appears on bottom of screen

review_comments: Is the change intentional? Before you had != Marginsmode::disabled and now you have ==

yes since variables on OverlayRender are changed we have
DISABLED only when overrides are disabled
INSIDE_VIDEO when overrides are enabled with position inside video

so in this case we need to enable it when set as disabled
maybe better to rename `MarginsMode::DISABLED` to something like `MarginsMode::NATIVE`
